title: Set response metadata
summary: Phoenix: Set response metadata. Inspect the cache header.
introduction: put_resp_header adds a header to the connection. Open GET /note.

blocks.text: Create an app named school with mix phx.new school --no-ecto --no-html --no-assets. Enter school and run mix deps.get. Put each labelled section in its named file, then run mix phx.server. Use http://127.0.0.1:4000.

blocks.title: Set response metadata
blocks.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
get "/note", LessonController, :note
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def note(conn, _params), do: conn |> put_resp_header("cache-control", "no-store") |> text("Practice note")
end

blocks.text: The header call returns a changed connection that text uses for the final reply.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use lower-case header names with Plug.
